item.title: [No Priors] The Changing Physics of Cybersecurity and Drug Development with OpenAI President Greg Brockman
item.description:
Speaker 1 | 00:00 - 00:19 To ensure AGI benefits all of humanity, we think that humans should be firmly in the driver's seat, should have control over the future, and this technology should amplify human agency. When I look at the world we're going to be in, where software in some ways is becoming like the barrier to entry, it's becoming so cheap. You don't just want software. Right? You want software that is reliable, that is secure, that you can believe in.
